name: quizzical
description: - **Fetch Questions:** Pull questions from the Open Trivia Database (OTDB) API. - **Display UI:** Render questions alongside interactive choice buttons. - **Answer Evaluation:** Check and score user choices upon submission. - **Tally Display:** Present the final score and round results once completed.
author: thidas

scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: npm run dev --prefix backend & npm run dev --prefix frontend
